propositions: Jira work spans multiple layers with fragmented retry ownership; a single postcondition can cross nested loops and replay inconsistently after late failures
No existing mechanism models terminal failures with stable per-ticket versus batch scope; the only breaker is a per-pass blast-radius guard, not an endpoint-failure fuse
Each logical postcondition must complete within three physical invocations and 15 seconds cumulative sleep, with provider delays deferred via retry_not_before rather than retried early
An endpoint-failure scoped fuse must trigger after three consecutive exhausted eligible outcomes across at least two tickets, distinct from and retained alongside the existing blast-radius guard
Create operations must use label-first containment (rebar-id:<local_id>), optional property enrichment, and known-key safety-abort if local persistence fails
Live external integration against both Jira Cloud and Jira Data Center with real transports and credentials is a required gate before epic closure
